scenario: [LCAP.2.10] / [LDIA.3.3.7]: the storage and samples-plane capabilities are deferred in this edition, and a `use` block line setting one `true` is refused with DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DEFERRED. `sampled_slots: true` needs nothing else ([LCAP.3.8] has no row for it), so no constraint check could refuse the block instead, and the program uses no construct it gates: a compiler without the refusal compiles it. PATH PINNED: the [LCAP.2.10] arm of the deferred-setting check in override resolution in `dsc.dialect` (`lcap_2_10_deferred_line`).
rules_ds:
use default:
    sampled_slots: true

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Int mutable

rule r:
    Sensor
->
    log info "x"
